test_per_tensor_dequant: test the per tensor FP8 linear weight dequantization using _dequant_fp8_linear_weight with a scalar weight_scale
test_per_channel_dequant: test the per channel FP8 linear weight dequantization with out_features or in_features scale vectors
test_devstral_model_structure: test converting a Devstral FP8 linear layer to bfloat16 using check_and_mark_quantized_module and convert_module_to_hp_if_necessary
dequant_fp8_linear_weight: dequantize an FP8 linear weight tensor to bfloat16 using a per tensor per channel or block wise scale
convert_fp8_module_to_high_precision: convert an FP8 quantized module to a high precision nn.Linear module with dequantized bfloat16 weights
